name: Hypertension
description: Abnormally high blood pressure, a common medical condition where the force of blood against artery walls is consistently too high.

name: Body Mass Index (BMI)
description: A measure of body fat based on height and weight, used to screen for weight categories that may lead to health problems.

name: Glucose
description: A simple sugar that serves as the primary energy source for the body. Elevated levels may indicate diabetes or prediabetes.

name: Blood Pressure
description: The force of blood pushing against artery walls. Measured as systolic (during heartbeat) over diastolic (between beats).

name: Cholesterol
description: A waxy substance found in blood. High levels of LDL cholesterol increase risk of heart disease and stroke.

name: Resting Heart Rate
description: The number of heartbeats per minute while at rest. Normal range is 60-100 bpm; deviations may indicate cardiovascular issues.

name: Age
description: Patient age in years. A significant risk factor for cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and cancer.

name: Sex
description: Biological sex of the patient (male or female). Influences risk profiles for cardiovascular disease and breast cancer.

name: Chest Pain Type
description: Classification of chest pain: typical angina, atypical angina, non-anginal pain, or asymptomatic. Key indicator for heart disease.

name: ST Depression
description: Exercise-induced ST-segment depression on ECG, measured in millimeters. A marker of myocardial ischemia and heart disease.

name: Major Vessels (Fluoroscopy)
description: Number of major vessels (0-3) colored by fluoroscopy. Indicates extent of coronary artery disease.

name: Thalassemia
description: An inherited blood disorder affecting hemoglobin production. Thalassemia status is a risk factor in heart disease datasets.

name: Insulin
description: A hormone that regulates blood glucose levels. Elevated insulin levels may indicate insulin resistance or type 2 diabetes.

name: Skin Thickness (Triceps)
description: Triceps skinfold thickness in millimeters, used as an indicator of body fat and metabolic health.

name: Pregnancy Count
description: Number of times the patient has been pregnant. A risk factor for gestational diabetes in the Pima dataset.

name: Diabetes Pedigree Function
description: A function that scores the likelihood of diabetes based on family history. Higher values indicate greater genetic predisposition.
